verdict.rationale: TaxJar's API reference says it provides official API clients for seven languages: Ruby, Python, PHP, Node, C#/.NET, Java and Go. The official taxjar-node GitHub repo documents concrete SDK methods such as createOrder, validateAddress and nexusRegions, and the guides walk through setting up the API client. Missing for 10: independent or community hands-on corroboration of SDK quality and maintenance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: We currently provide API clients for the following languages: Ruby Sales Tax API, Python Sales Tax API, PHP Sales Tax API, Node Sales Tax API, C# / .NET Sales Tax API, Java Sales Tax API, Go Sales Tax API
You’ll learn how to set up the API client, authenticate with TaxJar, and make common requests using our sales tax API
